@name: Runemage
@slug: runemage
@source: essence_companion
@realms: Essence, Channeling
@prime_stats: Em, In, SD
@description:
 Runemages are Hybrid spell users of Essence and Channelling who concentrate
 on the power written and spoken language have over the reality. Generally,
 all Runemages are Nomenist spell casters, though they rarely choose the
 Training Package for Nomenist Casters. The Runemages have their own base
 list, which is more refined than the standard Nomenist Caster spell list.
 Runemages use their power of language to create variable enchantments such as
 wards, symbols, and runes, while using their knowledge of the Primal Tongue
 to manipulate the physical world and the creatures within it.
